Container.Name: Fightarr
Container.Overview:
UFC event manager for Usenet and Plex. Automatically searches, grabs, renames, and imports UFC fight cards -- the Radarr for UFC that Radarr refuses to be.
IMPORTANT -- PATH SETUP (read before installing):
Fightarr needs to see two things: where SABnzbd puts completed downloads, and where your Plex media library lives. The defaults below match the most common Unraid layout:
/mnt/user/downloads -> /downloads (SAB drops finished files here) /mnt/user/Plex -> /plex (your Plex library root)
After install, go to Fightarr Settings -> Media Management and set Root Folder to /plex/UFC Shows (adjust if your UFC subfolder inside Plex has a different name).
In SABnzbd Settings -> Categories, create a category named "ufc" and set its folder to the path inside /downloads where SAB puts that category (e.g. /downloads/complete/ufc). Fightarr picks up completed downloads from that path automatically.
NOTE ON HARDLINKS: Hardlinks only work when /downloads and /plex live on the same Unraid array or pool. If they are on different shares/pools, open Fightarr Settings -> Media Management and disable "Use Hardlinks" -- Fightarr will copy instead. The original file is deleted by SAB on its normal cleanup schedule.
TRaSH-Guides /data layout: If you prefer a single unified mount, change the Downloads path to /mnt/user/data -> /data, mirror that in SABnzbd and Plex, and set Root Folder to /data/media/ufc. See the Fightarr README Unraid section for the full walkthrough.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web UI and API port. Default 7879 avoids conflict with Radarr (7878). Access Fightarr at http://[IP]:[PORT:7879]/

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Stores the SQLite database (fightarr.db), all settings, and API keys. Never share this folder with another container.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Where SABnzbd (or your other download client) saves completed downloads. Must be the same physical share that SAB writes to -- Fightarr reads completed files from here before moving them to Plex. Example: /mnt/user/downloads

Config.Name: Plex Media
Config.Description: Root of your Plex media share. Fightarr renames and moves imported UFC files into a subfolder here (e.g. /plex/UFC Shows). Must be the same physical share Plex reads from. Example: /mnt/user/Plex

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Run-as user ID. 99 = nobody on Unraid. Must match the owner UID of your Downloads and Plex shares so Fightarr can read and write files.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Run-as group ID. 100 = users on Unraid.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File permission mask. 002 = group-writable, matches Radarr/Sonarr defaults.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone (e.g. America/New_York, America/Chicago, America/Los_Angeles, Europe/London). Affects scheduled task timing and log timestamps.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR. Use DEBUG only when troubleshooting.

Config.Name: TMDB API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Better poster art from TMDB. Poster art works automatically via Wikipedia without this key.

Config.Name: Plex Host
Config.Description: Optional. Plex server URL for automatic library refresh after import. Example: http://192.168.1.10:32400. Can also be set in Fightarr Settings -> Connect.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Optional. Plex authentication token (X-Plex-Token). Find it in Plex Web: click your avatar -> Account -> find token in any API URL.

Config.Name: Plex Section ID
Config.Description: Optional. Plex library section ID to refresh after import. Leave blank to refresh all sections. Find the ID in Plex Web under your library URL.

Config.Name: Jellyfin Host
Config.Description: Optional. Jellyfin server URL for library refresh after import. Example: http://192.168.1.10:8096

Config.Name: CORS Origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated allowed CORS origins, or * to allow all. * is fine for LAN-only. Tighten if reverse-proxying to the internet.

Config.Name: Schedule Refresh Interval
Config.Description: How often (seconds) to sync the UFC schedule from Wikipedia. Default: 21600 (6 hours).

Config.Name: Indexer Search Interval
Config.Description: How often (seconds) to RSS-search indexers for monitored missing events. Default: 1800 (30 minutes).
